description: This file defines the PlatformCapsData class and associated functions for managing platform capabilities, quirks, browser info, plugin management, and device features in a media platform environment. It includes configuration parsing, RFC parameter retrieval, and feature flag logic.

classes.name: PlatformCapsData
classes.description: Class managing platform capability data, including quirks, browser info, plugin management, and feature flags.

methods.name: AddDashExclusionList
methods.description: Adds DASH playback exclusions based on RFC and device properties.

methods.name: GetQuirks
methods.description: Returns a list of platform-specific quirks and feature flags.

methods.name: GetBrowser
methods.description: Retrieves browser information based on configuration files.

methods.name: SupportsTrueSD
methods.description: Indicates if TrueSD is supported based on compile-time flags.

methods.name: CanMixPCMWithSurround
methods.description: Determines if PCM can be mixed with surround sound based on device output ports.

methods.name: GetFirmwareUpdateDisabled
methods.description: Checks if firmware update is disabled based on the presence of a specific file.

methods.name: DeviceCapsFeatures
methods.description: Returns a map of device capability features and flags.

methods.name: GetMimeTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of supported MIME types (currently a placeholder).

methods.name: getAvailablePlugins
methods.description: Retrieves a map of available plugins based on configuration files.

methods.name: verifyLibraries
methods.description: Verifies the existence of plugin libraries listed in configuration.
